heading: Te temepara Orbital
description:
he mahi toi, he amiorangi hoki i te wāhi mokowhiti.
Tukua mai he ingoa, ā, whakaponohia: ka kake ki te rangi.
I tētahi rā, whakapono mai, kāore rānei, ka hinga, ka tahuna.
